comment: The wire layout of OutWit.Controller.AI.Smt.Model: the Model package version and, for every MemoryPack type, its members in wire order with name, type and the value a new instance holds. Once a version of the package is published, a member is only ever appended, with the next order; a member that changes its name, its type, its place or its default is a wire change for a deployed fleet and for every application built against the package. Update this file in the same commit as the type (SmtModelWireLayoutTests prints the current layout when it differs).
